test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit between M and J. O sits to the immediate left of J. No one sits to the right of I. Only two people sit between I and O. N sits to the immediate right of L. How many people sit between K and N?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) No one sits to the right of I.

2) Only two people sit between I and O. 

3) O sits to the immediate left of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51e5bc865204068c13f73af7e9e60c87f6aeeab91bc57e943efe82de3580c786.png] 

4) Only three people sit between M and J.

5) N sits to the immediate right of L.

After positioning all only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8b3ab965c61d40a633e0fbcc87a930a607d7943967608fdedbec0bc54c37a97.png] 

Thus, two people sit between K and N.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
